recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, moody urban scene featuring a solitary figure in a long coat walking past a dark storefront, characterized by deep shadows and a vibrant, hand-lettered script logo in the upper quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright, warm-toned script contrasts against the dark, cool-toned urban background.
The long shadow of the pedestrian anchors the bottom left, balancing the text in the top left.
The dark storefront creates a large field of negative space that emphasizes the subject and the lettering.
coreInvariants: Fluid, connected script lettering with a distinct color pop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A solitary figure is positioned in the lower-left corner, scaled to approximately one-third of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant script logo in the top-left serves as the primary focal point, followed by the figure's shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright script at the top left, down to the figure, and follows the shadow across the pavement toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space occupies the center and right-center, representing a storefront in deep shadow.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale grey (pavement and figure highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the bright pavement and dark building; low saturation in the environment with high saturation in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a triadic scheme of black, white, and one warm accent

letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with a large, stylized uppercase initial
Variable stroke width mimicking a brush or marker
Long, sweeping descenders and crossbars that extend horizontally
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'C' has a wide, open loop
The final letter features a long horizontal tail that underlines part of the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script; any secondary text should be small, sans-serif, and tucked into architectural details.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn energy of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, high-contrast black and white photograph of a man in a trench coat walking on a sunlit sidewalk past a pitch-black storefront. The man's shadow is long and stretches toward the right. The overall mood is noir and urban.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, hand-drawn cursive script in a terracotta orange color to the top-left corner. The script should have a long horizontal flourish extending from the final letter.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the top-left corner?
Is the background high-contrast with deep blacks?
Is the lettering a warm, saturated orange?
Is the figure in the lower-left quadrant?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the orange accent
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the pedestrian
postGenerationChecks: Check that the script does not obscure the figure.
Ensure the black areas are truly dark without digital noise.
Verify the orange color pops against the dark background.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the heavy left-side weighting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Noir + High Contrast B&W Photography + Vibrant Hand-Lettered Script Overlay
